==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsʌm.ə.ɹi/}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-summary.ogg|a=US}}
* {{homophones|en|summery}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{inh|en|enm|summary}}, from {{der|en|la-med|summārius}}, from {{der|en|la|summa|t=total, sum}} + {{m|la|-ārius|pos=suffix forming adjectives}}.<ref>{{R:OED Online|pos=adj|id=3676674299}}</ref><ref>{{R:MED Online|entry=summārī|pos=adj|id=MED43732}}</ref>

====Adjective====
{{en-adj}}

# [[concise|Concise]], [[brief]]{{,}} or [[presented]] in a [[condensed]] form<!--{{glossary|patient}}-oriented aspect-->; presenting information in such a form<!--{{glossary|agent}}-oriented aspect-->.
#: {{syn|en|summative#Adjective|summarizing<qq:[[participial adjective|part. adj.]]>}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|abstractive#Adjective}}
#: {{ux|en|A '''summary''' review is in the appendix.}}
# [[perform|Performed]] [[speedily]], without [[formal]] [[ceremony]]{{,}} and (especially) without regard to [[legality]].
#: {{nearsyn|en|extrajudicial}}
#: {{ux|en|They used '''summary''' executions to break the resistance of the people.}}
# {{lb|en|legal}} Performed by omitting the [[procedure]]s of a full trial, but within a legally valid framework.
#: {{hyper|en|expedited#Adjective|expeditious}}
#: {{ux|en|The matter was brought to a close by '''summary''' dismissal of the cases.}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''summary''' executions caused outrage.}}

===Etymology 2===
From {{bor|en|la-med|summārium}}, from {{der|en|la|summa|t=total, sum}} + {{m|la|-ārium|pos=suffix forming nouns of purpose}}.<ref>{{R:OED Online|pos=n|id=8532453854}}</ref>

====Noun====
{{wp}}
{{en-noun}}

# An [[abstract]] or a condensed [[presentation]] of the [[substance]] of a [[body]] of [[material]].
#: {{ux|en|I'd forgotten what happened in the first ''{{w|Harry Potter}}'' book so I read a '''summary''' of the narrative before starting the second one.}}
#: {{ux|en|make a '''summary''' of the events}}
